title: Google — Year in Search 2019
description: Throughout history, when times are challenging, the world goes looking for heroes. And this year, searches for heroes — both superheroes and everyday heroes — soared around the world. annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is a Google Year in Search 2019 retrospective about public interest in superheroes and everyday heroes. Its montage and narration present rescue references, guide-runner imagery, a public march, and hero-related search overlays, with the visible destination being Google's Year in Search page. The described material contains no financial offer, payment request, investment participation, private-data submission, or deceptive benefit condition.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary subject is general inspirational and entertainment-oriented content: a year-in-review montage about heroes, sports, rescue-related scenes, family moments and public events.
